question: Will the Ornn Compute Price Index (OCPI-H100) for the H100 exceed $2.70 at any point on Friday, Jul 24, 2026 UTC?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the Ornn Compute Price Index for the H100 (OCPI-H100, Bloomberg ticker ORNNH100), as published by Ornn, reaches a value strictly above $2.70 (USD per GPU-hour) at any point during Friday, 24 July 2026 UTC, as evidenced by any transaction-level print or published index value recorded on Ornn's official platform or Bloomberg Terminal (ticker ORNNH100) for that UTC day.
- "No": Wins if the OCPI-H100 does not reach a value strictly above $2.70 (USD per GPU-hour) at any point during Friday, 24 July 2026 UTC.

Clarifications:
- "Exceed $2.70" means the index value is strictly greater than $2.70; a reading of exactly $2.70 does not satisfy the "Yes" condition.
